content:
Based on the knr-ops patterns described, here's the idiomatic implementation. I'll create a `base/` with kustomize overlays for `dev`/`prod`, plus the Flux kustomization.

## Directory Layout

```
infra/
  s3-logs/
    base/
      kustomization.yaml
      bucket.yaml
      versioning.yaml
      encryption.yaml
      public-access-block.yaml
    overlays/
      dev/
        kustomization.yaml
        patch-bucket.yaml
      prod/
        kustomization.yaml
        patch-bucket.yaml
  iam/
    logs-irsa/
      base/
        kustomization.yaml
        role.yaml
        policy.yaml
      overlays/
        dev/
          kustomization.yaml
          patch-role.yaml
        prod/
          kustomization.yaml
          patch-role.yaml
flux/
  kustomizations.yaml   (append logs kustomization)
```

---

## `infra/s3-logs/base/`

### `bucket.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: myapp
    app.kubernetes.io/component: logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    # region + bucket name are patched per-overlay
    forceDestroy: false
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default
```

### `versioning.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: BucketVersioning
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucketRef:
      name: myapp-logs
    versioningConfiguration:
      - status: Enabled
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default
```

### `encryption.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucketRef:
      name: myapp-logs
    rule:
      - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
          - sseAlgorithm: AES256
        bucketKeyEnabled: true
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default
```

### `public-access-block.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucketRef:
      name: myapp-logs
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default
```

### `kustomization.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - bucket.yaml
  - versioning.yaml
  - encryption.yaml
  - public-access-block.yaml
```

---

## `infra/s3-logs/overlays/dev/`

### `patch-bucket.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucket: myapp-logs-dev
    region: us-east-1
```

### `kustomization.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
namespace: ack-system
resources:
  - ../../base
patches:
  - path: patch-bucket.yaml
    target:
      kind: Bucket
      name: myapp-logs
commonLabels:
  env: dev
```

---

## `infra/s3-logs/overlays/prod/`

### `patch-bucket.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucket: myapp-logs-prod
    region: us-east-1
    forceDestroy: false
```

### `kustomization.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
namespace: ack-system
resources:
  - ../../base
patches:
  - path: patch-bucket.yaml
    target:
      kind: Bucket
      name: myapp-logs
commonLabels:
  env: prod
```

---

## `infra/iam/logs-irsa/base/`

The IRSA role: an IAM Role with an OIDC trust policy scoped to a specific ServiceAccount, plus a least-privilege inline policy limited to the logs bucket ARNs.

### `role.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: myapp
    app.kubernetes.io/component: logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    # assumeRolePolicy (OIDC trust) is patched per-overlay because the
    # OIDC provider ARN + account differ per cluster/env.
    assumeRolePolicy: |
      {}
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default
```

### `policy.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: RolePolicy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-rw
spec:
  forProvider:
    roleRef:
      name: myapp-logs-irsa
    # policy document is patched per-overlay to reference env bucket ARN
    policy: |
      {}
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default
```

### `kustomization.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - role.yaml
  - policy.yaml
```

---

## `infra/iam/logs-irsa/overlays/dev/`

### `patch-role.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa
spec:
  forProvider:
    assumeRolePolicy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Principal": {
              "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::111111111111:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEV_OIDC_ID"
            },
            "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
            "Condition": {
              "StringEquals": {
                "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEV_OIDC_ID:sub": "system:serviceaccount:myapp:myapp-logs",
                "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEV_OIDC_ID:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
              }
            }
          }
        ]
      }
```

### `patch-policy.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: RolePolicy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-rw
spec:
  forProvider:
    policy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Sid": "ListBucket",
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": ["s3:ListBucket", "s3:GetBucketLocation"],
            "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev"
          },
          {
            "Sid": "ReadWriteObjects",
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": ["s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject", "s3:DeleteObject"],
            "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev/*"
          }
        ]
      }
```

### `kustomization.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
namespace: ack-system
resources:
  - ../../base
patches:
  - path: patch-role.yaml
    target:
      kind: Role
      name: myapp-logs-irsa
  - path: patch-policy.yaml
    target:
      kind: RolePolicy
      name: myapp-logs-rw
commonLabels:
  env: dev
```

---

## `infra/iam/logs-irsa/overlays/prod/`

### `patch-policy.yaml` (least privilege — **no wildcard actions in prod**)
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: RolePolicy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-rw
spec:
  forProvider:
    policy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Sid": "ListBucket",
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": ["s3:ListBucket", "s3:GetBucketLocation"],
            "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-prod"
          },
          {
            "Sid": "ReadWriteObjects",
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": ["s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject", "s3:DeleteObject"],
            "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-prod/*"
          }
        ]
      }
```

### `patch-role.yaml` (prod OIDC trust)
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa
spec:
  forProvider:
    assumeRolePolicy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Principal": {
              "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::222222222222:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/PROD_OIDC_ID"
            },
            "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
            "Condition": {
              "StringEquals": {
                "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/PROD_OIDC_ID:sub": "system:serviceaccount:myapp:myapp-logs",
                "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/PROD_OIDC_ID:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
              }
            }
          }
        ]
      }
```

### `kustomization.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
namespace: ack-system
resources:
  - ../../base
patches:
  - path: patch-role.yaml
    target:
      kind: Role
      name: myapp-logs-irsa
  - path: patch-policy.yaml
    target:
      kind: RolePolicy
      name: myapp-logs-rw
commonLabels:
  env: prod
```

---

## The ServiceAccount (IRSA consumer)

Add this to your app overlay so the role is actually assumable. The role ARN annotation is populated per env.

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
  namespace: myapp
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/myapp-logs-irsa   # patched per env
```

---

## `flux/kustomizations.yaml` — append these

Two separate Flux Kustomizations (dev + prod) that reconcile the logs bucket independently, with a dependency on the IRSA IAM resources.

```yaml
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: s3-logs-dev
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  path: ./infra/s3-logs/overlays/dev
  prune: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: flux-system          # matches existing repo GitRepository source
  dependsOn:
    - name: iam-logs-irsa-dev
  healthChecks:
    - apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
      kind: Bucket
      name: myapp-logs
      namespace: ack-system
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: iam-logs-irsa-dev
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  path: ./infra/iam/logs-irsa/overlays/dev
  prune: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: flux-system
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: s3-logs-prod
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  path: ./infra/s3-logs/overlays/prod
  prune: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: flux-system
  dependsOn:
    - name: iam-logs-irsa-prod
  healthChecks:
    - apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
      kind: Bucket
      name: myapp-logs
      namespace: ack-system
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: iam-logs-irsa-prod
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  path: ./infra/iam/logs-irsa/overlays/prod
  prune: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: flux-system
```

---

## Notes on the choices & acceptance criteria

- **Versioning / AES256 / public-access-block**: each is a discrete ACK CRD linked to the `Bucket` via `bucketRef` — this is the idiomatic upbound/ACK S3 pattern (not inline sub-blocks).
- **Environment isolation**: dev and prod are separate overlays reconciled by separate Flux Kustomizations → changing prod never touches dev state (criterion 7).
- **Least privilege**: policies are scoped to exactly the env bucket ARN with only `Get/Put/Delete/List`; **no wildcard actions**, satisfying criterion 4 for prod.
- **SOPS**: no plaintext secrets are involved for a bucket + IRSA role (ARNs/OIDC IDs are not secret). If you inject the role ARN into the app via a Secret, encrypt that file with SOPS and ensure the Flux Kustomization has `decryption.provider: sops` referencing the age/KMS key — but bucket/IAM manifests here contain no sensitive material, so no SOPS envelope is added to avoid dead encryption.
- **Source ref**: `flux-system` GitRepository is assumed to be the existing bootstrap source — adjust the `sourceRef.name` if your repo uses a different `GitRepository`/`OCIRepository`.

Before applying, replace the placeholders: account IDs (`111111111111`/`222222222222`), OIDC IDs (`DEV_OIDC_ID`/`PROD_OIDC_ID`), and regions to match your actual EKS clusters.

Want me to also generate the SOPS-encrypted Secret + app ServiceAccount overlay wiring if your app consumes the role ARN via env?
